subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – form autoresponder email
body_text:
Hi Rohan,

Thank you for speaking with us. You told us that leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not going to them.

What we completed during the call:
- Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it.
- You submitted a test lead from your page and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived in your inbox.

What we discussed:
- We explained that you can verify your sender domain under email domain in settings, so that mails do not go to spam.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F3

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
caveats: A garbled support remark about an extension and an invoice could not be established and was left out.
